subject: Order form: invoicing cadence, tax evidence & payment orchestration
body:
From: Anna Ruiz <anna@heliohealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Glen Carter <procurement@heliohealth.com>, HelioHealth Finance <finance@heliohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form - split invoicing / tax evidence request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and finance have a couple of follow-ups on the Order Form before we can execute:

- Can Redwood issue separate invoices per Helio department (R&D / Production) under the same Order Form, or do you require a single consolidated invoice? Procurement prefers department-level invoices so they can route to different GL codes.
- If split invoices are possible, how will minimum commits and usage be allocated per invoice? Will credits/overages be applied across invoices or centrally?
- We need tax residency evidence from Redwood for our tax team to validate VAT handling.

Attached: Helio_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf (our proposed redlines).

Can you confirm options and any operational constraints? Our target is to sign by the end of this month.

Thanks,
Anna Ruiz
Director, Finance Operations
HelioHealth

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Glen Carter <procurement@heliohealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form - split invoicing / tax evidence request

Hi Anna — good questions, and appreciate the redlines. Short answers up front and proposed next steps below.

Options on invoicing: 
1) Consolidated monthly invoice with internal breakout lines: Redwood issues a single monthly invoice; we include line-item breakdowns (product lines + department allocation). This minimizes transaction overhead and preserves the existing billing pipeline. Credits/overages would be netted on the consolidated invoice and then allocated on an internal remittance schedule.
2) Department-level invoices: We can issue separate invoices per department/PO, but this requires explicit PO mapping and may trigger a modest operational fee depending on routing complexity. Also, minimum commit allocation needs to be agreed per department in the Order Form to avoid cross-department shortfalls.

Tax evidence: we can accept a Tax Residency Certificate/letter. Marcus, can you confirm the specific tax document format (certified copy vs. statement) we accept? I put together a proposed invoice cadence spreadsheet to illustrate both options.

Next steps: Marcus to confirm net terms and any fee for split invoices; Laura to confirm whether a short Order Form clause can allow per-department invoicing and clarify tax responsibility. If we all agree, I'll circulate a brief commercial amendment for signature (DocuSign).

Attachments: Proposed_Invoice_Schedule.xlsx

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Anna Ruiz <anna@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Glen Carter <procurement@heliohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form - split invoicing / tax evidence request

Anna / Kimberly — quick financial note from our side: 

- Split invoices: operationally feasible, but we need one of the following in place: (a) a clear PO per invoice with GL mapping, or (b) an internal allocation schedule signed by both parties. The bookkeeping and AR reconciliation overhead increases with more invoice targets.
- Minimum commit allocation: if Helio wants minimum commitments split across departments, those amounts have to be explicit in the Order Form (we can't implicitly allocate to multiple invoices). If a department falls short, the shortfall invoice will be generated to the department unless you elect to consolidate shortfalls centrally.
- Net terms: our standard is Net30. We can agree to Net45 for enterprise procurement cases, but that would require approval from Finance and may change the payment milestone in the Order Form (affects our cash planning).
- Tax documents: we accept a signed Tax Residency Certificate or a government-issued certificate of tax residency. PDF with the company stamp is preferred.

If Anna sends the certificate, I can confirm acceptance and flag any VAT handling notes. Also flagging potential ACH remittance vs wire fees if payments are split.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

---
From: Anna Ruiz <anna@heliohealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Glen Carter <procurement@heliohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form - split invoicing / tax evidence request

Hi all — attaching the tax doc requested.

Attachment: TaxResidencyCertificate.pdf

We are comfortable with either approach (consolidated with internal allocation or departmental invoices). Procurement prefers Net45; finance prefers department-level invoices for GL mapping. Our ask: can Redwood accept Net45 and issue department-level invoices under a single Order Form if we provide POs and a signed allocation schedule? Also want to confirm invoice appearance: will tax/VAT amounts be shown per invoice line, and how will credits be issued if there is an overage?

Thanks,
Anna

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@heliohealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form - split invoicing / tax evidence request

Anna — thanks for the certificate and the clarity. From legal's perspective we can accommodate Helio's preferred setup with three small changes to the Order Form / commercial appendix: 

1) Add an "Invoice Allocation Schedule" exhibit to the Order Form that sets the department-level minimum commits and GL/PO mappings. This makes allocations explicit and avoids downstream disputes.
2) Add an "Tax Responsibility" clause: Redwood will charge sales tax/VAT where required by law; Helio will provide tax residency evidence to support any zero-rating or exemption. Any retroactive tax assessments attributable to incorrect/absent certificates will be the responsibility of the party that failed to provide valid evidence.
3) Change payment terms block to allow Net45 if approved by Finance (we will add an approval checkbox in the signature block) and clarify the dispute/credit flow (30-day invoice dispute window; credits applied to next invoice unless otherwise instructed).

If you confirm those three items, I will prepare a commercial amendment (tracked redline) that we can put through DocuSign. I'll reference the Helio_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf you sent and incorporate the allocation exhibit.

Suggested next steps:
- Helio to confirm they will supply POs per department and accept the Allocation Schedule exhibit.
- Kimberly to confirm whether Redwood will levy a per-invoice operational fee for >3 invoice targets (Finance indicated there may be such a fee).
- I will prepare a one-page amendment and route for signatures.

I'll attach a short redline to the Order Form once I draft it. Proposed signing link after internal approvals: https://docusign.net/hellink/abc123

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

[Attachments referenced above]
